landing.heroTitle: Welcome to the Rotaract IUGB Club tombola
landing.heroLede: Log in, buy a ticket, pay at the club, then follow the draw. One account for every club tombola.
landing.step1Text: Register once. The same account follows you from one tombola to the next: ceremonies, meetings, and other club events.
landing.step2Text: Choose how many tickets you want. Numbers are assigned at random, only when an organizer confirms payment.
landing.step3Text: Cash at the club, or Wave. Only paid tickets enter the draw.
landing.step4Text: The organizer chooses the format: scratch tickets, or a public wheel that everyone watches.
landing.donateText: You can also donate via Wave. Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club, receives the payments.

buy.title: Buy tickets
buy.intro: Log in, then buy. Pay in cash or via Wave. Tickets, with a random number, appear only when the club confirms payment.
buy.introScratch: After the draw, scratch to see if your number won a prize.
buy.introRoulette: The draw is public, on the wheel: everyone sees who wins.
buy.needAccount: Create an account or log in to buy tickets. The same account follows every club tombola.

donate.lede: Support the club’s work. Donations go through Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club.

donate.cashText: You can also give cash to a club organizer.

auth.registerLead: One account for every club tombola. You can follow your tickets from one event to the next.
auth.name: Name
auth.termsTitle: General terms of use, participation and sale of tombolas
auth.acceptTerms: I have carefully read the General Terms of Use, Participation and Sale of Tombolas of Rotaract Club IUGB. I acknowledge that I have understood them and I accept without reservation the provisions that apply to me. I acknowledge in particular that reserving a ticket does not constitute payment, that only tickets that have actually been paid and validated take part in the draw, that the result depends on the draw mechanism provided for the tombola, and that a ticket may confer no prize.
auth.acceptEmails: I agree that Rotaract Club IUGB may use my email address to send me communications relating to its tombolas, events, invitations, fundraising and news.
